opmobility.name: OPmobility
opmobility.description: OPmobility is a French automotive supplier that operated under the name Plastic Omnium until March 27, 2024. It is based in France and serves the automotive industry.

orange-polska.name: Orange Polska
orange-polska.description: Orange Polska SA is a Polish telecommunications provider established in December 1991. It offers services including PSTN, ISDN, GSM networks, ADSL, FTTH fibre Internet, and others. The company is publicly traded on the Warsaw Stock Exchange with a controlling stake owned by Orange S.A.

olympus-corporation.name: Olympus Corporation
olympus-corporation.description: Olympus Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of optics and reprography products headquartered in Hachioji, Tokyo. Founded in 1919 as Takachiho Seisakusho, it initially specialized in microscopes and thermometers before expanding into imaging. The company adopted its current name in 2003.

omron.name: Omron
omron.description: Omron Corporation is a Japanese electronics company based in Kyoto, Japan. It was established by Kazuma Tateishi in 1933 and incorporated in 1948. The company operates in the electronics industry.

oversea-chinese-banking-corporation.name: Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation
oversea-chinese-banking-corporation.description: Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation Limited (OCBC) is a Singaporean multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered at the OCBC Centre. It operates over 400 branches in 19 countries including Malaysia, Indonesia, China, Hong Kong, and Macau.

oki-electric-industry.name: Oki Electric Industry
oki-electric-industry.description: Oki Electric Industry Co., Ltd., commonly known as OKI, is a Japanese information and communications technology company headquartered in Tokyo. It operates in over 120 countries globally.

osaka-gas.name: Osaka Gas
osaka-gas.description: Osaka Gas Co., Ltd. is a Japanese gas company based in Osaka, Japan. It supplies gas to the Kansai region, especially the Keihanshin area. The company is commonly written as 大阪ガス.

orica.name: Orica
orica.description: Orica Limited is an Australian multinational corporation that provides commercial explosives and blasting systems to mining, quarrying, oil and gas, and construction markets. It also supplies sodium cyanide for gold extraction and offers ground support services in mining and tunnelling.

optimum-communications.name: Optimum Communications
optimum-communications.description: Optimum Communications, Inc. is an American telecommunications provider controlled by Patrick Drahi. It offers digital cable television and broadband services primarily in the New York metropolitan area and other U.S. states.

omv-petrom.name: OMV Petrom
omv-petrom.description: OMV Petrom S.A. is a Romanian integrated oil company controlled by Austria's OMV. It is the largest oil and gas producer in Southeast Europe and one of Romania's largest corporations. Since 2004, it has been a subsidiary of OMV.

oshkosh-corporation.name: Oshkosh Corporation
oshkosh-corporation.description: Oshkosh Corporation is an American industrial company that designs and builds specialty trucks, military vehicles, and airport fire apparatus. It owns Pierce Manufacturing and JLG Industries. The company operates in the automotive industry sector.

ozon.name: Ozon
ozon.description: Ozon Holdings PLC is a Russian e-commerce company established in 1998 as an online bookstore. It became one of the three biggest online retail platforms in Russia by 2019. It is sometimes called the Amazon of Russia.

orlen-unipetrol.name: Orlen Unipetrol
orlen-unipetrol.description: Orlen Unipetrol is a Czech oil refining and petrochemical company based in Prague and owned by the Polish energy group Orlen. It operates refineries producing petrol, diesel, polyethylene, and polypropylene, and runs a network of filling stations in the Czech Republic, Slovakia, and Hungary.

oci-company-ltd.name: OCI Company Ltd.
oci-company-ltd.description: OCI Company Ltd. is a chemical company founded in 1959 with its head office in Seoul, South Korea. The company's name is an initialism of its former corporate name, Oriental Chemical Industries.

omnivision-group.name: OmniVision Group
omnivision-group.description: OmniVision Integrated Circuits Group, Inc. is a Chinese publicly listed fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Shanghai. It operates in the semiconductor industry.

orbital-sciences-corporation.name: Orbital Sciences Corporation
orbital-sciences-corporation.description: Orbital Sciences Corporation was an American aerospace company specializing in the design, manufacture, and launch of small- and medium-class space and launch vehicle systems. It served commercial, military, and government customers. In 2014, it merged with Alliant Techsystems to form Orbital ATK, later acquired by Northrop Grumman.

ovhcloud.name: OVHcloud
ovhcloud.industry: Data processing, hosting and related activities
ovhcloud.description: OVHcloud, legally OVH Groupe SA, is a French cloud computing company headquartered in Roubaix, France. Founded in 1999 by the Klaba family, it offers VPS, dedicated servers, and other web services. In 2019, it adopted OVHcloud as its public brand name.

oberbank.name: Oberbank
oberbank.description: Oberbank AG is an Austrian regional bank headquartered in Linz. It is part of the 3-Banken-Gruppe along with BKS Bank AG and Bank für Tirol und Vorarlberg AG (BTV).

oatly-ab.name: Oatly AB
oatly-ab.description: Oatly Group AB is a Swedish food company producing oat-based dairy alternatives, including oat milk. Founded in the 1990s with research from Lund University, it is headquartered in Malmö with a production and development center in Landskrona.

orbotech.name: Orbotech
orbotech.description: Orbotech Ltd. is a technology company headquartered in Yavne, Israel, and a subsidiary of KLA Corporation. It provides electronics reading, writing, and connecting solutions for manufacturers of printed circuit boards, flat panel displays, and other electronic components. The company operates globally including North America, Europe, Japan, and Asia-Pacific.

oricon.name: Oricon
oricon.description: Oricon Inc. is a Japanese holding company established in 1999 that supplies statistics and information on music in Japan and Western music. It originated from Original Confidence Inc., founded in 1967, and took over the Oricon record charts in 2002. The company is known for its music charts.

orexo.name: Orexo
orexo.description: Orexo is a Swedish pharmaceutical company that develops improved pharmaceuticals using innovative formulation technologies. It commercializes drugs and digital therapies in the US to treat opioid use disorder and other diseases, and develops products for other therapeutic areas worldwide with partners.

ola-electric.name: Ola Electric
ola-electric.description: Ola Electric Mobility Limited is an Indian electric vehicle manufacturer based in Bengaluru. Founded in 2017 by Bhavish Aggarwal, it designs and manufactures electric two-wheelers and has a manufacturing facility in Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu.

oklo.name: Oklo
oklo.description: Oklo Inc. is a publicly traded American nuclear power company based in Santa Clara, California. It develops a small modular nuclear reactor called the Aurora Powerhouse and plans to sell electricity and radioisotopes produced by these reactors. The company's name is derived from a region in Gabon, Africa.

oneok.name: ONEOK
oneok.description: Oneok, Inc. is an American oil and gas midstream operator headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma. It provides gathering, processing, fractionation, transportation, and storage services to the oil and gas industry. The company was founded in 1906 as Oklahoma Natural Gas Company and renamed Oneok in 1980.

ogk-2.name: OGK-2
ogk-2.description: OGK-2 is a Russian power generation company with a majority of its stock owned by Gazprom.

otis-worldwide-corporation.name: Otis Worldwide Corporation
otis-worldwide-corporation.description: Otis Worldwide Corporation is an American company that develops, manufactures, and markets elevators, escalators, moving walkways, and related equipment. It is known by its former legal name Otis Elevator Company and styled as OTIS. The company operates in the United States.

ono-pharmaceutical.name: Ono Pharmaceutical
ono-pharmaceutical.description: Ono Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in Japan, headquartered in Chuo-ku, Osaka. It has major plants in Osaka and Shizuoka, and its central research institute is located in Osaka Prefecture.

omz.name: OMZ
omz.description: OMZ, also known as United Heavy Machinery or Uralmash-Izhora Group, is a Russia-based international heavy industry and manufacturing conglomerate. It manufactures steel, custom, and industrial components for nuclear power plants, petrochemical and mining operations, and utilities, including reactor pressure vessels for VVER nuclear reactors and EKG mining power shovels.

osisko-metals.name: Osisko Metals
osisko-metals.description: Osisko Metals Incorporated is a Canadian mining corporation holding two historical past-producing mines: the Pine Point Mine in the Northwest Territories and the Gaspé Copper mine in Quebec. The company aims to reactivate these mines.

office-depot.name: Office Depot
office-depot.description: The ODP Corporation, known as Office Depot, is an American office supply retailer headquartered in Boca Raton, Florida. It employs about 19,000 people in the United States.

okuma-corporation.name: Okuma Corporation
okuma-corporation.description: Okuma Corporation is a Japanese machine tool builder based in Ōguchi, Aichi Prefecture. It has a global market share in CNC machine tools including lathes and machining centers and also offers factory automation products and servomotors.

oncolytics-biotech.name: Oncolytics Biotech
oncolytics-biotech.description: Oncolytics Biotech Inc. is a biotech company headquartered in San Diego, California, developing an intravenously delivered immuno-oncolytic virus called pelareorep for treating solid tumors and hematological malignancies. Pelareorep is a proprietary isolate of the reovirus that induces selective tumor lysis and promotes immune responses.

ovintiv.name: Ovintiv
ovintiv.description: Ovintiv Inc., based in Denver, is an American hydrocarbon exploration company. Formerly known as Encana, it restructured in 2020 from a Canadian to a U.S. domiciled company. Its operations focus on the Permian Basin in the U.S. and the Montney Formation in Canada, where it partners with Mitsubishi.

oceanagold-philippines.name: OceanaGold Philippines
oceanagold-philippines.description: OceanaGold Corporation is a gold mining and exploration company based in Vancouver, Canada, and Brisbane, Australia. It was previously known as Macraes Mining Company and GRD Macraes.

outotec.name: Outotec
outotec.description: Outotec Oyj was a Finnish company headquartered in Espoo that provided technologies and services for the metal and mineral processing industries. In 2020, it merged with Metso Minerals to form Metso Outotec. The company specialized in industrial technology solutions.

omnicom-group.name: Omnicom Group
omnicom-group.description: Omnicom Group Inc. is an American multinational media, marketing, and corporate communications holding company headquartered in New York City. It provides services in advertising, customer relationship management, public relations, and specialty services including media planning, digital marketing, and brand consultancy.

oi.name: Oi
oi.description: Oi, formerly Telemar, is a Brazilian telecommunications company headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. It was the largest fixed telephone operator and the fourth largest mobile operator in Brazil, ranking third in Latin America.

ormat-technologies.name: Ormat Technologies
ormat-technologies.description: Ormat Technologies, Inc. is an international company based in Reno, Nevada, United States. It supplies alternative and renewable geothermal energy technology and has built over 190 power plants. The company also produces turbines, generators, and heat exchangers.

ossur.name: Össur
ossur.description: Össur hf. is an Icelandic company that develops, manufactures, and sells non-invasive orthopaedic equipment including bracing, support products, compression therapy, and prosthetics. It is headquartered in Reykjavík and has offices in the Americas, Europe, and Asia with distributors in other markets.

one-gas.name: ONE Gas
one-gas.description: One Gas, Inc. is a fully regulated natural gas utility company in the United States. It operates as a stand-alone, publicly traded entity and is among the largest natural gas utilities in the country.

on24.name: ON24
on24.description: ON24 is a cloud-based platform company in the United States that develops and sells web-based webinar, virtual conferencing, content hub, and landing page applications as a service. It serves marketing and sales teams in B2B organizations and expanded its offerings in 2023 to include generative AI services.

organovo.name: Organovo
organovo.description: Organovo Holdings, Inc. is a biotechnology company headquartered in San Diego, California. Founded in 2007, it designs and develops functional, three-dimensional human tissue for medical research and therapeutic applications using its internally developed NovoGen MMX Bioprinter for 3D bioprinting.

omnivision-technologies.name: OmniVision Technologies
omnivision-technologies.description: OmniVision Technologies Inc. is an American subsidiary of the Chinese semiconductor design house OmniVision Group. It designs and develops digital imaging products for various applications including mobile phones and automotive systems. The company is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with offices in the US, Western Europe, and Asia.

opko-health-inc.name: Opko Health Inc.
opko-health-inc.description: OPKO Health, Inc. is a medical test and medication company focused on diagnostics and pharmaceuticals. It is publicly traded on NASDAQ and TASE under the symbol "OPK". The company operates in the healthcare sector.

oil-states-international.name: Oil States International
oil-states-international.description: Oil States International, Inc. is an American multinational corporation providing services to oil and gas companies. It is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

osterreichische-post.name: Österreichische Post
osterreichische-post.description: Austrian Post provides postal services in Austria. Established in 1999 after splitting from the state-owned Post und Telekom Austria AG, it is listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange.

owens-illinois.name: Owens-Illinois
owens-illinois.description: O-I Glass, Inc. is an American company specializing in container glass products. It is the largest manufacturer of glass containers across North America, South America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe. The company operates in the product packaging industry.

optimus-telecomunicacoes.name: Optimus Telecomunicações
optimus-telecomunicacoes.description: Optimus Comunicações, S.A. was a Portuguese mobile operator providing GSM, UMTS, and LTE services. It was a wholly owned subsidiary of Sonaecom. In 2014, Optimus merged with ZON Multimédia to form a new company called NOS.

oncomed.name: OncoMed
oncomed.description: OncoMed Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was an American pharmaceutical development company headquartered in Redwood City, California. Founded in 2004, it focused on developing targeted antibodies against cancer stem cells and was acquired by Mereo BioPharma in 2019.

oklahoma-gas-electric.name: Oklahoma Gas & Electric
oklahoma-gas-electric.description: Oklahoma Gas & Electric Company is a regulated electric utility serving customers in Oklahoma and Arkansas. It is the leading subsidiary of OGE Energy Corp., headquartered in Oklahoma City. OGE Energy previously owned Enogex Inc., which merged to form Enable Midstream, later sold in 2021.

ocean-rig.name: Ocean Rig
ocean-rig.description: Ocean Rig UDW Inc. was a Cyprus-based operator of semi-submersible oil platforms and underwater drillships headquartered in Athens. The company was acquired by Transocean in 2018.

oil-search.name: Oil Search
oil-search.description: Oil Search was the largest oil and gas exploration and development company incorporated in Papua New Guinea. It operated all of the country's oilfields. In December 2021, it merged with Santos.

open-text-corporation.name: Open Text Corporation
open-text-corporation.description: Open Text Corporation is a global software company based in Canada. It develops and sells information management software.

opera.name: Opera
opera.description: Opera Norway AS is a multinational technology corporation headquartered in Oslo, Norway, with offices in Europe, China, and Africa. It offers PC and mobile web browsers, gaming portals, news content products, advertising platforms, and Web3 and e-commerce services. Opera is recognized for browser innovation and early adoption of AI, cryptocurrency, and Web3 technologies.

outfront-media.name: Outfront Media
outfront-media.description: Outfront Media, Inc. is an American advertising company operating billboards, logo signs, and transit displays focused on outdoor advertising. It operates within the United States and includes both billboard and transit display advertising.

obi-pharma-inc.name: OBI Pharma, Inc.
obi-pharma-inc.description: OBI Pharma, Inc. is a bio-pharmaceutical company based in Nangang District, Taipei, Taiwan. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry focusing on biopharmaceutical products.

orange-belgium.name: Orange Belgium
orange-belgium.description: Orange Belgium is a Belgian telecommunications company operating internet and mobile services in Belgium and Luxembourg. It acquired VOXMobile in 2007, which was rebranded under the Orange brand. The company competes with Proximus and Base in the telecommunications market.

ondeck-capital.name: OnDeck Capital
ondeck-capital.description: OnDeck Capital is an American small business lending company with offices in multiple U.S. cities. It provides loans exclusively online using proprietary software and algorithms to determine loan eligibility based on business data.

orient-securities-co-ltd.name: Orient Securities Co., Ltd.
orient-securities-co-ltd.description: Orient Securities, also known as DFZQ, is a Chinese investment bank and brokerage firm founded in 1998 and headquartered in Shanghai. It is a constituent of the SSE 50 Index, the blue chip index of the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

octaware-technologies.name: Octaware Technologies
octaware-technologies.description: Octaware Technologies is a software development company based in Mumbai, India, incorporated in 2005. It is India's first sharia-compliant company listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange and operates internationally with subsidiaries and marketing offices.

onemain-financial.name: OneMain Financial
onemain-financial.description: OneMain Holdings, Inc. is an American financial services holding company headquartered in Evansville, Indiana. It operates OneMain Finance Corporation and subsidiaries, focusing on personal loans and optional insurance products for customers with limited access to traditional lenders.

oramed-pharmaceuticals.name: Oramed Pharmaceuticals
oramed-pharmaceuticals.description: Oramed Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a publicly traded company developing oral drug delivery systems, notably an oral insulin capsule for type 2 diabetes. Founded in 2006, it is headquartered in Jerusalem and listed on the NASDAQ Capital Market and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

old-mutual.name: Old Mutual
old-mutual.description: Old Mutual is a South African investment, savings, insurance, and banking group operating across Africa. Headquartered in Cape Town, it is listed on multiple stock exchanges including Johannesburg, Zimbabwe, Namibia, and Botswana.

overseas-chinese-town-enterprises.name: Overseas Chinese Town Enterprises
overseas-chinese-town-enterprises.description: Overseas Chinese Town Enterprises Co. is a Chinese state-owned enterprise supervised by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission. It is the parent company of several publicly traded companies and operates across multiple sectors and industries.

ol-groupe.name: OL Groupe
ol-groupe.description: OL Groupe is a French holding company established in 1999. It is primarily known for owning and managing the Olympique Lyonnais professional men's and women's football clubs and their stadium, Parc Olympique Lyonnais.

orient-group.name: Orient Group
orient-group.description: Orient Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese conglomerate headquartered in Harbin, Heilongjiang. It operates in finance, trading, construction, port, industry, tourism, and property development. It was the first Heilongjiang-based A share listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 1994.

onespan.name: OneSpan
onespan.description: OneSpan Inc. is an information security company based in Boston, Massachusetts. It provides services such as internet fraud prevention, multi-factor authentication, and electronic signature software. The company operates in the software industry.

obayashi-corporation.name: Obayashi Corporation
obayashi-corporation.description: Obayashi Corporation is a major Japanese construction company headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and is part of the Nikkei 225 index. In 2018, it was ranked 15th on ENR's list of Top 250 Global Contractors, the highest among Japanese contractors.

oji-holdings.name: Oji Holdings
oji-holdings.description: Oji Holdings Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of paper products and was the third-largest company in the global forest, paper, and packaging industry in 2012. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the Nikkei 225 stock index.

orbcomm.name: Orbcomm
orbcomm.description: ORBCOMM Inc. is an American company offering industrial IoT products to track, monitor, and control fixed and mobile assets across various markets. It provides hardware, modems, web applications, and data services via satellites and cellular networks.

orange-sky-golden-harvest.name: Orange Sky Golden Harvest
orange-sky-golden-harvest.description: Orange Sky Golden Harvest is a Hong Kong-based film production, distribution, and exhibition company. Previously known as Golden Harvest Entertainment Group until 2009, it dominated Hong Kong cinema box office sales in the 1970s and 1980s and helped introduce Hong Kong action films globally.

okta.name: Okta
okta.description: Okta, Inc. is an American identity and access management company based in San Francisco. It provides cloud software for managing and securing user authentication across applications and devices.

oil-refineries-ltd.name: Oil Refineries Ltd.
oil-refineries-ltd.description: BAZAN Group, formerly Oil Refineries Ltd., is an oil refining and petrochemicals company based in Haifa Bay, Israel. It operates the country's largest oil refinery and provides products and services for industrial operations, agriculture, and transportation.

osotspa.name: Osotspa
osotspa.description: Osotspa Public Company Limited is a Thai beverage producer known for drinks such as M-150 and Shark Energy. The company is based in Bangkok, Thailand. It operates in the beverage industry.

okaya-co.name: Okaya & Co.
okaya-co.description: Okaya & Co., Ltd. is one of the oldest still functioning Japanese trade companies, founded in Nagoya city in 1669. It was established as Okaya in 1937 and is a family business with over 200 years of history, also a member of the Henokiens association.

o-reilly-auto-parts.name: O'Reilly Auto Parts
o-reilly-auto-parts.description: O'Reilly Automotive, Inc., known as O'Reilly Auto Parts, is an American automotive parts retailer. Founded in 1957, it provides parts, tools, supplies, equipment, and accessories to professionals and do-it-yourself customers. The company operates more than 6,400 stores in the US, Puerto Rico, Mexico, and Canada.

odel.name: ODEL
odel.description: Odel is a public retail company in Sri Lanka and was the first department store in the country. It began as a single company focused on the retail garment trade and expanded over the years.

omnova-solutions.name: OMNOVA Solutions
omnova-solutions.description: OMNOVA Solutions, Inc. is a global manufacturer of laminates, performance films, and coated fabrics. Founded in 1999 after a spinoff from GenCorp, it is headquartered in Beachwood, Ohio. The company operates sales, manufacturing, and distribution locations across Europe and Asia.

osi-systems.name: OSI Systems
osi-systems.description: OSI Systems, Inc. is a California-based American company that develops and markets security and inspection systems, including airport X-ray machines and metal detectors, as well as medical monitoring and anesthesia systems. It includes subsidiaries such as Spacelabs Healthcare and Rapiscan Systems.

osk-holdings-berhad.name: OSK Holdings Berhad
osk-holdings-berhad.description: OSK Holdings Berhad is a publicly listed Malaysian company primarily focused on property development and manufacturing. It is majority-owned by individuals, with Executive Chairman Ong Leong Huat holding the largest share. The company has diversified from its original stockbroking and investment banking activities.

ocado.name: Ocado
ocado.description: Ocado Group plc is a British company based in Hatfield, England, that licenses grocery technology. It owns a 50% share in the UK grocery retail business Ocado Retail Ltd and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

ocean-power-technologies.name: Ocean Power Technologies
ocean-power-technologies.description: Ocean Power Technologies is a U.S. publicly owned renewable energy company specializing in electric power and communications solutions for remote offshore applications. Its PowerBuoy wave energy technology is scalable and can supply energy to the grid via submarine cables, though economic viability has been challenging.

ohara-corporation.name: Ohara Corporation
ohara-corporation.description: Ohara Inc. is a Japanese global glass manufacturing company headquartered in Sagamihara. Founded in 1935, it has subsidiaries in several countries including the U.S., Germany, and China, with Ohara Corporation serving as its U.S. subsidiary.

old-national-bank.name: Old National Bank
old-national-bank.description: Old National Bank is an American regional bank operated by Old National Bancorp, headquartered in Chicago and Evansville, Indiana. It has nearly 200 retail branches across several states and is one of the top 30 banking companies in the U.S.

old-republic-international.name: Old Republic International
old-republic-international.description: Old Republic International Corporation is an American company specializing in property and title insurance. It is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. The company operates within the insurance industry in the United States.

olin-corporation.name: Olin Corporation
olin-corporation.description: Olin Corporation is an American manufacturer producing ammunition, chlorine, and sodium hydroxide. It originated from two companies founded in 1892: Franklin W. Olin's Equitable Powder Company and the Mathieson Alkali Works. The company operates in the chemical manufacturing sector in the United States.

ollie-s-bargain-outlet.name: Ollie's Bargain Outlet
ollie-s-bargain-outlet.description: Ollie's Bargain Outlet is an American discount store chain founded in Mechanicsburg, Pennsylvania, in 1982. It sells a variety of discounted items, mostly overstock or closeout merchandise purchased in bulk from other retailers. The chain features caricatures of its namesake, Oliver "Ollie" Rosenberg, in its advertising.

olympic-steel.name: Olympic Steel
olympic-steel.description: Olympic Steel, Inc. is a metals service center based in Cleveland, Ohio. It processes and distributes various metals including carbon, coated and stainless steel, aluminum alloy, and tin plate primarily in the United States. The company serves the iron and steel industry.

omega-protein.name: Omega Protein
omega-protein.description: Omega Protein Corporation was a US company founded in 1913 as a fishing operation. It produced food ingredients, dietary supplements, and animal feed, including fish oil and fish meal. In 2017, it was acquired by Cooke Inc.

onyx-pharmaceuticals.name: Onyx Pharmaceuticals
onyx-pharmaceuticals.description: Onyx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was a pharmaceutical company headquartered in South San Francisco, California, focused on developing and marketing cancer treatment medications. Founded in 1992, it was acquired by Amgen in 2013. The company also acquired Proteolix in 2009 to expand its biotechnology portfolio.

ooma.name: Ooma
ooma.description: Ooma, Inc. is an American telecommunications company based in Silicon Valley, California. It provides communications services including voice over IP (VoIP) calling for business, home, and mobile users. The company is publicly traded.

ophir-energy.name: Ophir Energy
ophir-energy.description: Ophir Energy plc was an oil and gas exploration and production company based in London, United Kingdom. It owned operating and non-operating assets in Africa, Asia, and Mexico. The company focused on petroleum industry activities.

oppenheimer-holdings.name: Oppenheimer Holdings
oppenheimer-holdings.description: Oppenheimer Holdings Inc. is an American multinational independent investment bank and financial services company headquartered in New York City. It offers investment banking, financial advisory, capital markets, asset management, and wealth management services worldwide.

optical-cable-corporation.name: Optical Cable Corporation
optical-cable-corporation.description: Optical Cable Corporation is headquartered in Roanoke, Virginia, and manufactures fiber optical cable. Its products are used largely for telecommunications and sold in the US and over seventy other countries. It also produces military land tactical fiber optic cable for the U.S. military.

orient-overseas-international-limited.name: Orient Overseas (International) Limited
orient-overseas-international-limited.description: Orient Overseas (International) Limited (OOIL) is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company involved in international transportation, logistics, property investment, and development. It is the parent company of Orient Overseas Container Line (OOCL), a major container shipping company.

ofg-bancorp.name: OFG Bancorp
ofg-bancorp.description: OFG Bancorp is the financial holding company for Oriental Bank, headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico. Founded in 1964, it offers retail and commercial banking, lending, and wealth management primarily in Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands through its subsidiaries.

osiris-therapeutics.name: Osiris Therapeutics
osiris-therapeutics.description: Osiris Therapeutics, Inc. was an American company founded in 1993 following the identification of mesenchymal stem cells. It was launched with contributions from Dr. Arnold Caplan and investors, and relocated to Maryland in 1995 with state support. The company focused on biotechnology related to stem cells.

otter-tail-corporation.name: Otter Tail Corporation
otter-tail-corporation.description: Otter Tail Corporation is an electric power and manufacturing company based in Fergus Falls, Minnesota. Its subsidiaries include Otter Tail Power Company and several manufacturing firms. The company operates in the renewables and utilities sector.

owens-corning.name: Owens Corning
owens-corning.description: Owens Corning is an American company that develops and produces insulation, roofing, and fiberglass composites. Founded in 1935 as a partnership between Corning Glass Works and Owens-Illinois, it is the world's largest manufacturer of fiberglass composites. The company is known for its Pink Panther mascot featured in advertisements.

oxford-industries.name: Oxford Industries
oxford-industries.description: Oxford Industries, Inc. is a publicly traded American clothing company specializing in high-end apparel. It carries major labels such as Tommy Bahama, Lilly Pulitzer, Johnny Was, and Southern Tide. The company operates in the United States.

oxford-instruments.name: Oxford Instruments
oxford-instruments.description: Oxford Instruments plc is a UK-based manufacturing and research company that designs and produces tools and systems for industry and research. Headquartered in High Wycombe, England, it has sites across the UK, US, Europe, and Asia. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

onto-innovation.name: Onto Innovation
onto-innovation.description: Onto Innovation Inc. is an American semiconductor company formed in 2019 from the merger of Rudolph Technologies and Nanometrics Incorporated. It provides process and process control equipment and software for microelectronic manufacturing industries.

obsidian-energy.name: Obsidian Energy
obsidian-energy.description: Obsidian Energy Ltd. is a mid-sized Canadian oil and natural gas production company based in Calgary, Alberta. It operates within the petroleum industry in Canada.

origin-energy.name: Origin Energy
origin-energy.description: Origin Energy Ltd is an Australian integrated electricity generator and retailer headquartered in Sydney. It operates Australia's largest coal-fired power station, Eraring Power Station, and owns 20% of UK renewable energy retailer Octopus Energy.

one-medical.name: One Medical
one-medical.description: Amazon One Medical is a primary care health service in the United States offering in-person care and online resources, including a mobile app. Founded by 1Life Healthcare, Inc. in 2007, it was acquired by Amazon in February 2023 and integrated into Amazon's Prime membership offerings.

organon-co.name: Organon & Co.
organon-co.description: Organon & Co. is an American pharmaceutical company originally founded in Oss, The Netherlands, now headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey. It specializes in reproductive medicine, contraception, psychiatry, hormone replacement therapy, and anesthesia, producing all products outside the U.S.

orix.name: Orix
orix.description: ORIX Corporation is a Japanese diversified financial services group headquartered in Minato, Tokyo, and Osaka, Japan. It operates in various financial sectors, providing a wide range of services.

opendoor.name: Opendoor
opendoor.description: Opendoor Technologies Inc. is a San Francisco-based online company that buys and sells residential real estate. It offers instant cash offers, repairs homes, re-lists them, and provides mobile app-based home buying and financing services.

ouster.name: Ouster
ouster.description: Ouster, Inc. is an American lidar technology company based in San Francisco, California. It designs and manufactures high-resolution digital 3D lidar and native colour lidar sensors for use in various sectors including industrial, robotics, drones, and autonomous vehicles.

obrascon-huarte-lain.name: Obrascón Huarte Lain
obrascon-huarte-lain.description: Obrascón Huarte Lain, branded as OHLA Progress Enablers, is a Spanish multinational construction and civil engineering company. It is involved in infrastructure, commercial property construction, homebuilding, and transport concessions, with significant activity in Mexico and a majority-owned American subsidiary.

ogc-3.name: OGC-3
ogc-3.description: OGK-3 was a Russian power company whose stock was traded on the MICEX-RTS stock exchange. It operated in the energy sector before ceasing operations.

opus-global.name: Opus Global
opus-global.description: Opus Global is a Hungarian industrial conglomerate and asset management company headquartered in Budapest. Its subsidiaries play a significant role in Hungary's strategically important industries. The company operates primarily in the industrial sector within Hungary.

orion-corporation.name: Orion Corporation
orion-corporation.description: Orion Corporation is a Finnish pharmaceutical company founded in 1917 and headquartered in Espoo, Finland. It develops, manufactures, and markets human and veterinary pharmaceuticals and active pharmaceutical ingredients globally.

orange-morocco.name: Orange Morocco
orange-morocco.description: Orange Maroc, formerly known as Meditel, is one of the three major licensed telecommunications operators in Morocco. It offers mobile, fixed-line, cybersecurity, and mobile payment services.

odyssey-re.name: Odyssey Re
odyssey-re.description: Odyssey Re Holdings Corp. is an underwriter of property and casualty treaty and facultative reinsurance, as well as specialty insurance. Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, it operates globally through four divisions and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Fairfax Financial.

overland-airways.name: Overland Airways
overland-airways.description: Overland Airways is an airline based in Ikeja, Lagos State, Nigeria. Its main base is Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Ikeja, with a hub at Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport in Abuja.

odfjell-drilling.name: Odfjell Drilling
odfjell-drilling.description: Odfjell Drilling is an international drilling company based in Norway. Founded in 1973 with maritime roots dating back to 1914, it has experience in the petroleum industry since the mid-1960s. The company was listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange on 27 September 2013.

omx-helsinki-25.name: OMX Helsinki 25
omx-helsinki-25.description: OMX Helsinki 25 is a stock market index representing the 25 most traded stocks on the Nasdaq Helsinki stock exchange. It is a price return and capitalization-weighted index with a maximum weight limit of 10 percent for any single stock.

oil-and-natural-gas-corporation.name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation
oil-and-natural-gas-corporation.description: The Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) is an Indian government-owned oil and gas explorer and producer headquartered in Delhi. It accounts for about 70% of India's crude oil production and 84% of natural gas production. ONGC was founded in 1956 and has Maharatna status conferred by the Government of India.

orbite-aluminae.name: Orbite Aluminae
orbite-aluminae.description: Orbite Technologies Inc. was a Canadian cleantech company based in Montreal specializing in alumina extraction processes for the mining industry. Its Orbite process aimed to replace the Bayer process and treat red mud. The company declared bankruptcy in 2017 but rebranded as Advanced Energy Minerals by 2022, manufacturing high purity alumina at its Cap-Chat plant.

ogk-1.name: OGK-1
ogk-1.description: OGK-1, the First Generation Company of the Wholesale Electricity Market, was a large Russian electricity generation company formed by merging six electricity generation companies.

orbis.name: Orbis
orbis.description: Orbis is the oldest travel agency in Poland, founded in 1920 in Lwów. It is currently the largest hotel group in Poland and Central Europe, and the parent company of Orbis S.A. Capital Group with nine subsidiaries.

otokar.name: Otokar
otokar.description: Otokar Otomotiv ve Savunma Sanayi A.Ş., known as Otokar, is a Turkish manufacturer of buses and military vehicles headquartered in Sakarya, Turkey. It operates as a subsidiary of Koç Holding.

outokumpu.name: Outokumpu
outokumpu.description: Outokumpu Oyj is a group of international companies headquartered in Helsinki, Finland. It is the largest producer of stainless steel in Europe and the second largest in the Americas. The company also mines chromium ore for use in stainless steel production.

osram-licht-ag.name: OSRAM Licht AG
osram-licht-ag.description: OSRAM Licht AG is a German company headquartered in Munich and Premstätten, Austria, that manufactures electric lights. It focuses on photonics, sensor technology, visualization, and light treatment, serving consumer, automotive, healthcare, and industrial sectors.

omx-copenhagen-25.name: OMX Copenhagen 25
omx-copenhagen-25.description: The OMX Copenhagen 25 is the top-tier stock market index for Nasdaq Copenhagen, part of Nasdaq Nordic. It is a market value weighted index consisting of the 25 most-traded stock classes. It replaced the OMX Copenhagen 20 index.

oil-india.name: Oil India
oil-india.description: Oil India Limited is an Indian public sector company engaged in exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas. Headquartered in Duliajan, Assam, it operates under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas with offices in multiple Indian cities.

omnicare.name: Omnicare
omnicare.description: Omnicare, Inc. is an American healthcare company specializing in pharmacy services for nursing homes. It was established in 1981 as a spinoff from Chemed and W. R. Grace and Company. In 2015, Omnicare was acquired by CVS Health.

onvia.name: Onvia
onvia.description: Onvia, Inc. is an American government business intelligence company offering software products such as government leads and relationship management tools. It provides databases of government contracts and notifications of business opportunities. The company operates in the business intelligence sector in the United States.

omx-stockholm-30.name: OMX Stockholm 30
omx-stockholm-30.description: The OMX Stockholm 30 (OMXS30) is a stock market index representing the 30 largest and most traded stocks on the Nasdaq Stockholm stock exchange. It is a price return and modified free float capitalization-weighted index.

onex-corporation.name: Onex Corporation
onex-corporation.description: Onex Corporation is a Canadian investment management firm founded by Gerry Schwartz in 1984. It manages investments across various sectors and is based in Canada.

otp-bank.name: OTP Bank
otp-bank.description: OTP Bank Group is Hungary's largest commercial bank and a leading independent financial service provider in Central and Eastern Europe. It offers banking and financial services across 10 countries in the region.

ocp-group.name: OCP Group
ocp-group.description: OCP Group, formerly Office Chérifien des Phosphates, is a Moroccan state-owned company specializing in phosphate rock mining, phosphoric acid manufacturing, and fertilizer production. Founded in 1920, it is the world's largest producer of phosphate and related products.

oceanic-bank.name: Oceanic Bank
oceanic-bank.description: Oceanic Bank International was a Nigerian bank providing individual, commercial, and corporate banking services. It was among the top five leading banks in Nigeria.

orient-bank.name: Orient Bank
orient-bank.description: Orient Bank, now known as I&M Bank (Uganda) Limited, is a commercial bank licensed by the Bank of Uganda. It was rebranded after I&M Bank acquired 90 percent shareholding in Orient Bank. The bank operates in Uganda's financial services sector.

okx.name: OKX
okx.description: OKX, formerly known as OKEx, is a cryptocurrency exchange based in San Jose, California. It operates in the digital currency trading sector and has undergone a rebranding from its original name.

obvio.name: Obvio!
obvio.description: Obvio! is a Brazilian automobile manufacturer specializing in microcars. The company planned to sell cars in the US through ZAP and was wound down after the death of designer Anísio Campos in 2019.

o-boticario.name: O Boticário
o-boticario.description: O Boticário is a Brazilian cosmetics company operating 4,070 stores across Brazil and several other countries including Portugal, Mexico, and the United States. It is a major player in the cosmetics industry with an extensive international presence.

ok-bazaars.name: OK Bazaars
ok-bazaars.description: OK Bazaars is one of South Africa's oldest retail shops, established in 1927. The first store opened in Johannesburg and the brand grew to more than 100 shops nationwide.

ooredoo-algerie.name: Ooredoo Algérie
ooredoo-algerie.description: Ooredoo Algeria is a telecommunications company operating in Algeria. It provides telecom services within the country.

one-airlines.name: One Airlines
one-airlines.description: One Airlines was a Chilean airline providing passenger and mining charter flights since 2013. It operated a small fleet including Boeing 737 aircraft and was headquartered at Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport in Santiago. The airline ceased all operations on June 24, 2020.

oca.name: OCA
oca.description: Correo OCA is an Argentine company created in Córdoba in 1957 as a service management for Industrias Kaiser Argentina (IKA). It operates in the mail industry providing postal services.

odinsa.name: Odinsa
odinsa.description: Odinsa S.A is a Colombian publicly traded company specializing in construction and infrastructure development, including roads, airports, and railways. It operates in Colombia and the Caribbean, and also develops real estate projects through its subsidiary Odinsa Holding Inc.

obras-sanitarias-del-estado.name: Obras Sanitarias del Estado
obras-sanitarias-del-estado.description: The National Administration of State Sanitary Works (OSE) is the state-owned water utilities company in Uruguay. It is responsible for water supply services across the country.

orascom-construction-industries.name: Orascom Construction Industries
orascom-construction-industries.description: Orascom Construction PLC is an engineering, procurement, and construction contractor based in Cairo, Egypt. It was Egypt's first multinational corporation and operates in more than 25 countries.

orange-mali.name: Orange Mali
orange-mali.description: Ikatel was a telecommunications company in Mali affiliated with France Telecom. Since 2003, it was Mali's second mobile phone operator and was renamed Orange Mali on November 30, 2006.

ooredoo-tunisia.name: Ooredoo Tunisia
ooredoo-tunisia.description: Ooredoo Tunisia is a private telecommunications company founded in 2002 with capital of 330 million Tunisian dinars. It is part of the Ooredoo Group and is the largest operator in Tunisia with over 7.5 million subscribers.

orange-tunisia.name: Orange Tunisia
orange-tunisia.description: Orange Tunisia is a mobile phone operator that acquired a license in Tunisia in 2010. It became the leading 3G mobile operator and the second landline operator in the country. The Tunisian State confiscated 51% of the company in 2011 due to fraudulent licensing terms.

oxxo.name: OXXO
oxxo.description: Oxxo is a Mexican chain of convenience stores and gas stations headquartered in Monterrey, Nuevo León. It operates over 21,000 stores across the Americas and parts of Europe. It is the largest chain of convenience stores in Latin America.

ocean-star-cruises.name: Ocean Star Cruises
ocean-star-cruises.description: Ocean Star Cruises is a Mexican cruise line based in Mexico City, founded in 2010 as the first Mexican cruise line. Its first ship, Ocean Star Pacific, was purchased in 2010 and entered service in 2011.

orange-drc.name: Orange DRC
orange-drc.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
orange-drc.description: Orange RDC is a telecommunications company operating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with headquarters in Kinshasa. Originally a joint venture between ZTE and the Congolese state, it was fully acquired by France Télécom in 2011 and renamed Orange RDC in 2012.
